title: Future stability of large-data wave maps in energy-supercritical dimensions
summary: We consider energy-supercritical co-rotational wave maps from Minkowski spacetime to the sphere in odd spatial dimensions. The equation admits an explicit co-rotational self-similar blowup solution, which also induces solutions that blow up in the past. In the region after the blowup the solution treated in this paper is remarkable, as it is smooth forward in time and exhibits less than dispersive decay.
